events.name: TEST_EVENT
changes: Live notification test successful.
Anomaly status monitoring active.

title: The Father is the Enigma: The Legacy of Nigel Moyer

events.name: Nigel Moyer - Father's Day 2026
changes: Portal Keys are guaranteed to drop from all successful hacks.
The 'Nigel Moyer - Father's Day 2026' Premium Campaign is available for 15,000 CMU (rewards: special medal and tactical gear).
Re-release of the 'Archives: Susanna Moyer (2015)' medal as a standalone offering for a limited time.
Susanna Moyer physical merchandise available at the Ingress Store.

events.name: Operation Summer Solstice 2026
changes: Standard Campaign track allows earning Bronze and Silver tiers of the 'Summer Solstice 2026' medal and up to 3,000 Orion Tokens.
Premium 'Dark Star 2026' Campaign available for 15,000 CMU (rewards: exclusive medal).
XM substrate stability allows running 10 concurrent Kinetic Programs.

events.name: The Courier Files Campaign
changes: Free repeatable 'Hank Johnson: The Courier Files' Campaign available in the Scanner (repeatable up to 3 times).
Complete objectives to earn up to 3,000 Orion Tokens.

events.name: Emergency XMP Attack Radius Tuning
changes: XMP attack strength increased, but attack radius is temporarily reduced to prevent global write contention on database.
Fewer Portals are attacked per XMP fired during this window.

events.name: Free Anomaly Compensatory Load Out Kit
changes: Free Load Out Kit in the Store containing: 1 Aegis Shield, 4 Rare Multi-Hack, 20 Power Cube, 20 XMP, 20 Resonator, 8 Rare Heat Sink, 1 ADA Refactor, 1 JARVIS Virus, 1 Kinetic Capsule, 4 Very Rare Shield, 8 Rare Shield, 1 SoftBank Ultra Link.

title: The Mother is the Beacon: Honoring The Acolyte

events.name: Mother's Day Kinetic Capsule Boost
changes: Parallel processing limit for Kinetic Capsules increased from 7 to 13.
'The Acolyte - Mother's Day 2026' Premium Campaign is available for 15,000 CMU in the Store (rewards: special medal and XM items).
Exclusive The Acolyte physical merchandise available for a limited time at the Ingress Store.

title: Thank You For Adventuring With Us, Peridot Keepers

events.name: Peridot Keeper Commemoration Campaign
changes: Free 'Peridot Keeper' Campaign and Limited Edition Peridot medal available to all Agents.
Bounties include: hacking, capturing portals, deploying mods, deploying resonators, walking 5km, and creating links/fields.

events.name: Nemesis Challenge Redux Campaigns
changes: Three concurrent Campaigns: Myriad (Free), Umbra (15,000 CMU), and Courier (15,000 CMU) to earn or upgrade respective medals to Gold tier.
Reduced Portal hack cooldown patterns globally.
Experimental tuning for XMP Bursters and Portal Shields deployed during the event window.
2X AP bonus on deploying a Resonator, destroying a Resonator, and capping the 8th Resonator slot.
Bonus AP for Unique Portal Visits.
Surge in Machina activity globally as signatures grow stronger.

events.name: Orion Global Linking & Fielding Operation
changes: Earn Orion Global Op Points by creating/destroying links and fields (points credited in Dispatch interface).
Collaboration bonus: Create a Unique Field with 2 or 3 distinct owners to split 12 or 30 points.
Stage 1 Assignments reward the Orion Global Campaign Medal (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and up to 7,500 Orion Tokens.
Factions compete globally for 1,000 Season Points distributed pro-rata.

events.name: Sakura Blossom Festival 2026
changes: Global XM manifests as glowing, pink sakura petals drifting in the Scanner UI.
Free 'Sakura Blossom 2026' Campaign rewards the 'Sakura Blossom 2026' medal and 3,000 Orion Tokens.
Two advanced Campaigns ('Sakura Branch 2026' and 'Sakura Tree 2026') available for 15,000 CMU each in the store.
Redux Campaigns available to secure classic 2021 Sakura medals for 2,500 CMU each.

events.name: The Aberration Investigation Campaign
changes: Primary Campaign 'The Aberration' unlocked for all Agents.
Player activity determines progression paths: fortifying unlocks 'Superposition' campaign; destroying unlocks 'Dissolution' campaign.
Completing all three paths unlocks the ultimate 'Equilibrium' campaign.
Earn up to 3,800 +Gamma Tokens to upgrade the season medal.
Optional Premium campaigns 'Good Cat 2026' and 'Bad Cat 2026' available for 30,000 CMU.

events.name: Ingress Toast Day 2026
changes: Temporary Kinetic Program lets you convert 8 L1 Resonators into 2 Toast Beacons.
Archival Premium Campaign 'Toast Day Redux 2026' available for 15,000 CMU (rewards the 2022 Toast Medal or a Recursion Wing).
Free repeatable 'Toast Day 2026' Campaign dishing out Toast Beacons.
Warmth in XM network bakes Toast Glyphs into scanner hacks.

title: Gallop into Greatness with Ingress Year of the Horse! 🐎

events.name: Year of the Horse Celebration Campaign
changes: Year of the Horse Celebration Campaign available for 15,000 CMU via Dispatch.
Completing the first Assignment grants the exclusive 'Lunar New Year 2026' Year of the Horse medal.
